text_block_list.text: Question!

"A design combining water chestnuts, an 
annual plant of the Lythraceae family. 
Also said to originate from the kanji 'ta' 
(rice field), what is this famous family 
crest used by the Kai Takeda clan?"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The correct answer is the 
"Yotsuwaribishi"!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! Also known as the "Takedabishi." 
That was an easy question for a Sengoku 
era enthusiast like you.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha, praise me more! When it comes to 
me, even the toughest questions are a 
total piece of cake~~!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Come on Yaeno, next, next! Let's solve 
more and more to prepare for the real 
thing~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Why, the shopping district quiz 
tournament, of course!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
This time the category is "Sengoku," so 
losing is simply not an option!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The shopping district quiz tournament 
is a popular event held regularly in the 
nearby shopping arcade.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The prize is extravagant—a "One-Year Free 
Pass for Shopping District Food"—so a 
great many participants gather every time.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, there are many obscure questions, 
and it is famous for having many 
contestants disqualified for incorrect 
answers. In fact, in the previous 
tournament under the "Mythology" category—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The final question turned into a 
one-on-one duel between Tanino Gimlet-san 
and the quizmaster. Having answered 
correctly, Gimlet-san—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Silence, hold your tongue, Yaeno! The 
previous tournament is already water under 
the bridge.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
My battlefield lies within the "Sengoku" 
era! I shall show them my true power—bring 
it on!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Then, next question! The Sengoku warlord 
who later became widely known as the Tiger 
of Kai, Takeda Shingen. What is his formal 
full name?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Minamoto no Harunobu!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Continuing from that, what was his 
childhood name?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Taro!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Continuing further!! What is the name of 
the textbook of that era, written in 
epistolary style for general education, 
which that Taro was said to have read—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Teikin Orai!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent!! Every single answer is 
correct!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahahahaーー!! How about that?! The 
shopping district quiz tournament holds no 
terror for me!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
As a true warrior, believing that no other 
path lies before me, I shall command my 
own fate—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Everyone, forth into battle we march~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, brimming with certainty of 
victory, the day of the shopping district 
quiz tournament arrived—or so it was 
supposed to?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Whyyyy~~, wasn't it supposed to be 
today~~?!?!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Resident A
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, kiddo~ The quiz tournament was 
held last week. Well, don't let it get you 
down, try again next time!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To have gotten the date wrong... How 
careless of me. I should have known she is 
someone who messes up precisely at the 
most crucial moments...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Noooo~~, this can't be! My glorious 
overthrow of superiors! My unification of 
the realm~~!!
—Hmm-hmmm♪ Okonomiyaki, okonomiyaki♪

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...*sniffle*. Who dares be so carefree in 
such a dire crisis...—

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait for okonomiyaki♪ But are you 
sure it's okay? It was your victory prize, 
Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, totally fine~. I wouldn't have 
entered the quiz tournament if you hadn't 
invited me anyway.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And besides, the questions were pretty 
much all things No Reason-chan is always 
talking about! Talk about lucky~♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
So she was the champion... To think 
victory was snatched away right before our 
eyes...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: NOOOOOOOO~~~ HOW COULD THIS BE?!!!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The greatest blunder in the entire life of 
No Reason~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having had her guaranteed shot at victory 
stolen away, No Reason stamped her feet in 
bitter frustration.
